title: Equipment registry sharing and hand-prop classification crowd results
status: valid controlled diagnostic evidence; renderer timings remain shared-host descriptive results

conclusion.memory: The shared read-only equipment registry changed the exact 300-actor census from 300 mutable per-actor snapshots to one snapshot shared with Main. Median headless Godot static memory after spawn fell from 1503.263 MiB to 717.134 MiB; median static spawn delta fell by about 786.5 MiB.
conclusion.frame: All three optimized headless run means were near 22 ms, but tails overlap and the shared host drifted. Compatibility world render costs remain excessive and show no consistent whole-frame gain; rendered results are descriptive.
conclusion.remaining: The final diagnostic still measured 150 unique skeleton callbacks per frame; Main inclusive work averaged 1.014 ms and combat pose-from-skeleton callbacks averaged 1.712 ms.

sourceBasis.sharedHelperPolicy: candidate helper and the same native DLL remain present in both variants; baseline scripts do not reference the helper

measurementContract.interferenceLabel: shared host; unrelated Godot jobs authorized; activity not continuously monitored
measurementContract.processMemoryScope: periodic OS counters over full captured process lifetime, including startup/lifecycle; not exact steady frames
measurementContract.staticMemoryFields: memory.spawned.staticBytes is absolute post-spawn Godot static memory; memory.spawnDelta.staticBytes is the delta from the pre-spawn sample
measurementContract.renderedCaveat: single rendered A bracketed by two B processes per renderer; asynchronous captures and shared-host pacing do not prove a causal frame gain

existingRegressions.status: 2/2 passed using final runtime bytes before the clean freeze commit
